description: This file defines a Java interface 'FineractSuiteInitializerStep' with methods for suite initialization and reset, serving as a contract for test suite initialization steps in the Fineract project.

classes.name: FineractSuiteInitializerStep
classes.description: Interface for defining initialization and reset steps for Fineract test suites.

methods.name: initializeForSuite
methods.description: Method to perform initialization before a test suite runs.

methods.name: resetAfterSuite
methods.description: Default method to perform cleanup after a test suite; default implementation is a no-op.
